title: Unit 13 Consolidation: Irony, Satire & Reading Between the Lines

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can use aligha, korántsem, and éppenséggel to navigate polite doubt and emphatic denial.
I can signal shared premises and ironic complicity using hiszen and ugyebár.
I can formulate litotes, hedged statements, and social satire in writing.
